question: Can externally supervised action preferences teach a shared-depth model to request a missing value and then ground the answer in a real CSV file, while preserving its qualified public numerical calls?

Require strictly lower total wall time and peak bytes and better chosen-minus-rejected sequence log-probability margins on at least 32/48 held-out preference questions versus the frozen initial reference. File names, observation content, all IDs and actual public function evaluations are replayed. A miss closes deployment and follow-up for this fit. Passing licenses a fresh external document panel against the qualified tool parent before deployment and an equally fitted ordinary-depth control before attributing a gain to recurrence.

question: Can all-layer low-rank adaptation recover missing relationships in full-budget arithmetic without losing general language?

Report paired exact p regardless. A pass permits a separately registered independent replication, prose and 128K checks before promotion. Failure closes promotion and expansion of this checkpoint. Stop on host guard or budget.

At 256 require positive net answers on each source. V3 NLL must stay within +0.03 of Base. All conditions required before confirmatory replication or dense attribution. Preserve checkpoints and incomplete generations on resource stop; no tuning on these evaluation items.

Require a net gain of at least four completed correct answers over 56, positive net in at least two of five families, positive net across the full-budget arithmetic and entailment families, no losses in aggregate for any family, all four register answers correct, total generation seconds including routing and replay <= Base, exact ordinary fallback output IDs and identical V3 raw loss in all five domains. question: Does explicit first-pass supervision of required field availability make the repeated decoder ask before executing and finish correctly after clarification on real files and time zones?

A miss closes this state-supervised fit. Passing licenses equal native K1 training and an independently authored multi-turn suite before changing the default. No hidden reference state can be passed into inference.

question: Can a recurrent model learn to issue useful real document searches and bind its final answer to an observed passage, including on unseen scientific papers and on this project’s own user guides?
decision_rule: Require at least 14/40 completed exact answers grounded in a returned human-annotated source location and eight net above Base, exact paired p<=.05. All three source cohorts gain at least two grounded answers; SQuAD at least four. No fewer exact answers or completed requests and no lower mean token F1 in each source. Overall correct final answers at least six above Base and relevant annotated source locations retrieved on at least 20 requests. Both classes of the first-pass passage-evidence head score at least 65% on the document-held-out validation examples. Strictly lower summed first-token time and wall inclusive of indexing, and lower peak allocation. Full register, mixed assistant and depth attribution would require separate qualification; a failure closes this fit and its downstream jobs. A pass licenses an independent exact changed-source replay on actual user files and matched one-application training before an architectural claim.

question: Can the qualified offline two-pass tool model use an ordinary local full-text search API to read unfamiliar articles and scientific papers and return answers supported by the retrieved original text?
decision_rule: 12 of 32 exact location-grounded answers and six net above Base with exact two-sided matched p<=.05. Gain at least two grounded answers on each source. No decrease in normalized exact, mean token F1 or completed requests in either source. At least four net additional correct final answers, strictly lower cold-inclusive total and summed first-token times including index construction, and strictly lower peak. question: Does the same recurrent decoder improve genuinely semantic judgments on new premise triplets under a fourth unseen phrasing?

Require at least 4 net correct, positive per source, more complete correct triplets, higher common-prefix three-way probe accuracy, total actual generation seconds <=Base and raw V3 NLL <=Base+0.03. Both plain and tool views must reproduce native full-versus-incremental top-1 on the same actual prefix within .6 maximum logit error and use distinct native states for their shared layer. A miss closes this specific fit for promotion and its descendants. A pass licenses a matched one-application backbone with an equally trained bottleneck on identical data. Successful attribution must precede new user-authored field replication and independent physical >=131072-token and natural-prose qualification.
